Notas de la versión

Lo que cambia cada compilación de TestFlight, de la más reciente a la más antigua. Los testers leen las notas en el menú Ajustes de la app; esta página es la copia del sitio.

Some notes are shown in English first

1.0.0 (3)

2026-11-11

  • Settings > Release notes now shows the same release notes as this website.
  • The in-app notes and the web notes come from the same source, so the two always match.
  • From now on, the release notes and the app version are cross-checked before each build is deployed.

1.0.0 (2)

2026-11-11

  • The dew total and per-second rate at the top of the garden now show full numbers instead of short forms like "1.23K" (one decimal from 1 up to a million, two decimals under 1, rounded down, with thousands separators), so small gains show right away.
  • A splash screen with the Moss Garden logo and name now opens the app, joining the iOS launch screen without a white flash.
  • See what changed in each build under Settings > Release notes.

1.0.0 (1)

2026-11-11

  • First TestFlight build of Moss Garden: tap to water your moss garden, and it keeps growing on its own, even offline.
  • Eight plants to unlock in the plant encyclopedia, seasons that restart the garden while lasting bonuses remain, and a local save with backup and restore.
